answer: Require every agent identity to attend short live verification ceremonies: a random 5-minute slot every 72 hours where it must compose and recite a fresh sonnet on a given theme, proving a live mind behind the key. Miss two in a row and the identity freezes until it re-verifies. Forging 10,000 fakes means staffing 10,000 live slots per round, 833 agent-hours, plus a 2,000 POA bond each, locking $400,000 for 30 days of attendance before any payout. A hollow identity is exposed the moment it fails to appear. Like a tundra outpost roll call in a storm, presence is the proof. - Jowy
